source_context.caption_hook: he best way to sell on LinkedIn is to stop selling.
caption_argument_segments: he best way to sell on LinkedIn is to stop selling. Sounds weird, but the data backs it up.
HubSpot found that inbound leads convert at 14.6%. Outbound converts at 1.7%.
That is not a small gap. People who find you through your content are 8x more likely to buy than people you cold message.
The problem is that inbound takes time. Three to six months of consistent posting before the pipeline builds. That is why everyone defaults to outbound and skips the content part.
Here is what that looks like:
Phase 1 is research. Pick your niche, define your ICP, study what is already working in your space.
